run_hab3_benchmark: run a multi-process Habitat-Lab benchmark measuring FPS across N steps and GPUs
create_env_habitat: create a Habitat-Lab environment with GPU assignment and config options for benchmarking
sample_action_space_wrapper: sample random actions from a custom ActionSpaceWrapper for oracle_nav and humanoid_pick

step_env_HabDemoRunner: step the Habitat environment with an action and measure step execution time
